subject: Controlled upgrade runway, rehearsal & rollback criteria for AcmeBank private cluster
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmebank.com>, Acme Bank Infrastructure Team <infra@acmebank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Controlled upgrade runway, rehearsal & rollback criteria for AcmeBank private cluster

Oliver / Acme infra team —

Thanks again for partnering on the Private deployment upgrade. Per our call last week, I wanted to put a proposed runway and rehearsal plan in writing so we can sync on exact windows and acceptance criteria. High-level goals: keep customer traffic stable, validate rollback triggers automatically, and create a documented audit trail for your security/compliance team.

Summary of proposed approach (details attached in upgrade-playbook-v2.pdf):
- Version pinning window: we will pin the control plane to v2.14.1 for 72 hours prior to the upgrade to prevent auto-rolls.
- Canary cadence: 2 phased canaries — 5% traffic for 30m, then 20% for 90m.
- KV/cache considerations: prefix caching preserved; explicit KV flush only on failover path.
- Maintenance window request: target two potential windows (US-friendly): Aug 14 23:00 - Aug 15 03:00 PDT OR Aug 21 01:00 - 05:00 PDT. Prefer the first if you can.
- Rollback criteria (abort triggers): sustained 4xx/5xx rate > 1.5x baseline for 10m, latency p95 > 2x baseline for 10m, or canary model divergence on scoring tests > 8% error.
- Failover options: automatic fallback to hosted-compatible model variant in N. Virginia region (no data plane change; model variant has reduced throughput).
- Rehearsal: a dry-run on Aug 7 where we simulate canary promotion + rollback (no real traffic diversion, synthetic traffic only).

What we need from Acme: confirmation of maintenance window preference, acceptance of the rollback thresholds above, and a point-of-contact for the rehearsal day to approve simulated rollback. We included an Audit Trace template (audit-trace-template.xlsx) to capture events during the run.

I attached the playbook and audit template for your security reviewers. If these thresholds are too conservative/aggressive, we can adjust — I'm primarily focused on making the criteria measurable and automated.

Next steps: Oliver, can you confirm which window works and who will be the on-call approver for the rehearsal?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: upgrade-playbook-v2.pdf (17 pages), audit-trace-template.xlsx (spreadsheet), canary-metrics-dashboard.png (screenshot)

Cc: Acme Bank Infrastructure Team <infra@acmebank.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 08:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Controlled upgrade runway, rehearsal & rollback criteria for AcmeBank private cluster

Ben —

Appreciate the level of detail. A few quick clarifying items from our side before we lock windows: 
- Compliance will want the full audit trace retained for 90 days. Is that feasible by pushing logs to our audited S3 bucket (we have a Glue lifecycle in place)?
- For the canary, can we map the synthetic workload to our morning trading profile? We want coverage for the 95th percentile burst behavior.
- If we do a dry-run on Aug 7, can we also include a simulated KMS key rotation step? We want to ensure there are no surprises in the key refresh path.

If all of that works, Aug 14 window looks good for us. POC for rehearsal: myself (oliver.grant@acmebank.com) and Priya Mehta (priya.mehta@acmebank.com) from ops.

On the rollback thresholds — our security team will take a look this afternoon and come back with any changes. Expect a short note by EOD.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Infrastructure, Acme Bank
oliver.grant@acmebank.com

Ben / team —

Adding technical gating details and rollback play that Operations will execute. I pasted the key bullets here and attached the small runbook excerpt to the playbook PDF so everything is in one place.

Execution & gating details:
- Preflight checks (T-48h): cluster health >= 99.5%, replication lag < 200ms, disk watermark < 70%. If any check fails we automatically move the window by one week.
- Canary probes: 1) functional smoke (end-to-end success), 2) perf probe (p95 latency), 3) model correctness probe (if applicable). All three must pass to promote.
- Automated rollback script: a single command that triggers version revert, KV restore point, and traffic switch back to control lane. The script emits a signed event to the audit bucket; use audit-trace-template.xlsx to map events to timestamps.
- Abort hierarchy: engineer on-call may abort; if aborted, notify execs and create a P1 postmortem ticket in Jira SUP-2124 within 4 hours.
- Rollforward guardrail: if canary shows low errors but downstream backlog increases (consumer queue > 250k), we pause promotion and observe for 30m.

Data retention & KMS notes:
- We will stream audit traces to your S3 prefix s3://acmebank-logs/redwood-upgrades/ and set lifecycle to 90 days as requested. KMS rotation simulation will be part of the Aug 7 dry-run; we will use a staged rotated key and verify access before any production change.

Attachments referenced: upgrade-playbook-v2.pdf (updated page 9 runbook excerpt). Also added a small dashboard image (canary-metrics-dashboard.png) for clarity.

If that looks good, I will author the rehearsal checklist and send calendar invites for Aug 7 (dry-run) and Aug 14 (primary).

-Neha
